thread:
jamie: Quick sync 1 1 Need a compact activation playbook for AWS/GCP/Azure listing: owners, hard gates, demo pattern, and publish checklist. Aim: draft by EOD tomorrow.

sofia: I can own demo pattern + creds. Preference: tenant-scoped sandboxes, short-lived keys. Will post 1P pointer when ready.

raj: I'll assemble the owners table and the image matrix (AMI/GCP image family/Azure image SKU). Plan to include kernel/glibc notes and region exceptions.

natalie-legal: Legal items: localized EULA for EU/UK, export control sign-off on model weights, and clear trial-data retention language. If we include EU regions we may need translations (48-72h).

ken-eng: Image sweep started: ami-0f1e2d3c us-east-1, gcp family rfwd-core-stable-v2, azure sku RedwoodCore_2026. Flagging older Nitro hosts for compatibility.

nate-runtime: I'll add recommended instance SKUs, latency SLOs, and quantization guidance (8-bit for hosted; int4 on supported dedicated GPUs). Also include recommended batch sizes and prefix caching note.

sofia: Runbook snippet to rotate demo creds (I'll paste into 1P):
```bash
# example rotate (GCP)
gcloud iam service-accounts create rfwd-demo --display-name="rfwd-demo"
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create demo-key.json --iam-account=rfwd-demo@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# store demo-key.json in 1Password collection 'marketplace-demos' with TTL=5d
```

security: 1Password policy: collection name = "marketplace-demos", TTL = 5 days, one-time-view where possible, no keys in Drive, audit logging enabled, ACL = partnerships+platform.

dani-marketing: Marketing needs staging endpoints + short-lived tokens to capture hero screenshots and a 45-60s demo clip. Can we provide by Mon?

jamie: Timeline: Raj owners/table draft by Thu EOD, Sofia sandbox creds Fri AM, Natalie's legal notes Fri EOD (or sooner if translations required), Nate runtime notes Thu EOD, Marketing to schedule recording Mon.

raj: Uploaded draft sheet: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/onboard_playbook_placeholder 1 I'll populate AMIs and owners. Columns: cloud, region, image-id, publisher-account, sku, trial-flag, private-offer, demo-type, ops-owner, legal-owner, runtime-notes.

natalie-legal: Quick legal flag: avoid claims like "HIPAA-ready" or "data never leaves X" unless we have contracts. For dedicated SKU we can say "option for region-bound data storage" but ops must confirm.

ken-eng: Confirmed: Dedicated deployment can be configured for region-bound storage; will add exact limitation matrix.

sofia: Posting 1P pointer when sandboxes live. Will follow security TTL guidance.

marketplace-bot: Publisher portal: offer draft created (offer-id: rfwd-core-2026). Publisher invite link sent. Reminder: invite expires in 72h.

jamie: If publisher portal or image validation stalls, escalate here and I'll loop partner ops. Otherwise we'll iterate on the draft spreadsheet and convert to a one-pager for AWS team. :rocket:
